title: Jalaa language - Wikipedia
text: Jalaa (autonym: bàsàrə̀n dà jàlààbè̩), also known as Cèntûm, [2] Centúúm or Cen Tuum, is an extinct language of northeastern Nigeria (Loojaa settlement in Balanga Local Government Area, Gombe State), of uncertain origins, apparently a language isolate.
